a_bad_feeling.description:
Even the slightest change to ARC's behavior could spell disaster.

And that signal you heard? It's like nothing we've ever picked up. If they're up to something, we need to find out whatever we can.
a_bad_feeling.name: A Bad Feeling

objectives.0: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier

a_balanced_harvest.description: Our food production is finally enough to meet our basic needs, but what we really need now is variety. I have a lead on some agricultural research from before the First Wave. Are you in?
a_balanced_harvest.name: A Balanced Harvest

objectives.0.0: Go to the Research & Administration building

objectives.0.2: Search for any traces of the agricultural research project

a_better_use.description: We're short on everything but mouths to feed, yet Celeste's launching precious supplies into the air for Raiders to claw over. I’m done letting the good stuff go to waste.
a_better_use.name: A Better Use

objectives.0.0: Request in a Supply Drop from a Call Station
objectives.0.1: Loot a Supply Drop

a_dead_end.description:
I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing.

That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?
a_dead_end.name: A Dead End

a_first_foothold.description:
We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest.

My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.
a_first_foothold.name: A First Foothold

a_lay_of_the_land.description:
Those distant rumbles are getting less distant with each passing day.

I have a lead on some LiDAR scanners that may help us monitor the tremors. You do want to keep a roof over your head, don’t you?
a_lay_of_the_land.name: A Lay of the Land

a_path_not_yours.description: Before our paths changed, we lingered by the Blue Gate for some time. We believe there is an old trail from those days, and something belonging to us may still lie at its end.

after_rain_comes.description:
I know, I know! The power's down in sector—
Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long.

Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?
after_rain_comes.name: After Rain Comes

armored_transports.description:
Ever since we expanded the tunnels to the Blue Gate, some rare pieces have started appearing on the black market.

Meanwhile, I'm stuck here peddling battered old Rattlers. If I don't find new supply lines, I'll be left in the dust.
armored_transports.name: Armored Transports

back_on_top.description: Guess what? Shani asked me to help out with something, and for once, I’m actually glad she did. We’re setting up new outposts topside! Or, planning to, at least. Can you believe it?
back_on_top.name: Back on Top

boarding_the_frigate.description:
None of our old tactics work, facing those Frigates. We can’t run. We can’t hide. And there’s no waiting them out.

We need to take bold action, and we need to do it now.
boarding_the_frigate.name: Boarding the Frigate

objectives.0.0: Find a way on top of the Frigate
objectives.0.1: Establish a foothold on top of the Frigate

bombing_run.name: Bombing Run

objectives.0.1: Deliver a Bombardier Cell to Shani

broken_monument.description: I have another special site I need you to search for me. An old battlegrounds, from the First Wave. Raiders nowadays usually pick places like that clean, despite the significance they once held. People forget quickly. Quicker than they should.

celestes_childhood_drawings.description:
Say, pal, has Celeste seemed a bit down, to you? 

Listen, I think I know something that might brighten her day. Do you know the hotel around Riven Tides?
celestes_childhood_drawings.name: Celeste’s Childhood Drawings

Those Frigates looming in the sky… It made me feel shivers I haven’t felt since I was a girl. 

We need to adapt, I know. But the lessons we learned then? They're more relevant now than ever.
celestes_teenage_rebellion.name: Celeste's Teenage Rebellion

During the First Wave, the Barons did more damage than all the other machines combined. Now they’re mere husks; fixed in place where they once fell... 

Still, their internals might hold the answer to keeping ARC at bay. So open one up, and bring me whatever is inside.
dormant_barons.name: Dormant Barons

down_to_earth.description:
Raiders have long reported peculiar-looking crates dropping down from malfunctioning ARC Probes. 

If we can figure out a way to crack them open, we might get a better understanding of what it is they’re after.
